title: Round 3: measure the expansions

checklist.step: Count actual transitions and restore instrumentation
Draw your own naive and cached measurements

hints: A measurement counts an event when it happens. Which call marks one state being expanded?
Both solvers look up the global name transition each time they use it, so a replacement installed while the solver runs sees every call.
Declare transition global, keep the original, install a wrapper that adds one and calls the original, and restore the original in a finally block.

questions.prompt: Why does the cached solver expand n positive states?

choices.text: Every call is a cache miss
choices.why: Many calls can reuse a stored answer.
Algorithm drawing is excluded and these solvers do not draw.

choices.text: Each positive remainder is expanded once
choices.why: The length-1 dependency reaches every positive remainder, and caching prevents repeated expansion.
